name: r5-e3-tc-k48-pair
author: solx-loop
description: E3/H26: each K stage is 48 k instead of 32 (an SW128 32-k box plus an SW64 16-k box per operand, 12 UMMAs and one commit per stage, a 3-stage ring of 58-66 KB). This puts 1.5x the MMA work behind each commit and hides the ~900-1200 clk per-stage floor of 32-k rings wherever N < ~470. One kernel (two TMEM accumulators, nb = ceil(B/512) batch tiles, no CUTLASS) covers every B > 256. With L2-hot W, the 48-k stage at Bpad 384 runs at the MMA ideal (1175 vs 1152 clk).
